# Leyoxa

> Leyoxa LLC makes local businesses with a physical location the one AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Siri, Perplexity, Copilot) recommend, understand and book: consistent listings, machine-readable services, prices and hours, an agent-completable booking path, an AI receptionist, and a monthly AI visibility report. Serves the United States and Canada; not healthcare, dental, legal or accounting.

Every page is also published as markdown. Contact: contact@leyoxa.com. Founder: Sepehr Aflatounian (https://sepehrafla.github.io).

## Pages

- [Home](https://leyoxa.com/index.md): What Leyoxa does, how AI assistants choose a business, and who it is for.
- [Questions](https://leyoxa.com/faq.md): Answers about getting a local business recommended and booked by AI assistants — what AI visibility is, which assistants matter, whether AI can book, cost and how to start.
- [How it works](https://leyoxa.com/how-it-works.md): How Leyoxa gets a local business found, understood and booked by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini and Siri — the free check, the fixes, booking and the monthly report.
- [Praxis](https://leyoxa.com/praxis.md): Before local businesses, Leyoxa built Praxis for dentists — six AI agents in production, from a voice agent that answers and books patient calls to AI search visibility.
